incremental.unit: changed published topic plus exact locale
incremental.safe_reuse: passage-hash and full compatibility-key verified vector cache only
incremental.fallback: unknown manifest membership, schema/normalization/version or compatibility drift requires the affected full-locale rebuild

promotion: Build every affected artifact in private staging, validate manifest/source hashes, locale coverage, citations and compatibility, then atomically replace its pointer. A partial candidate never replaces the last verified generation.
stale_failure: A source-manifest, version, chunk, vector, compatibility or pointer mismatch fails release validation and chat abstains; deterministic search remains available.
